ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, signatories, and material counterparties of the Hong Kong investor and the proposed PRC WFOE must be screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority residential and enforcement advisories under the AMLO Cap. 615, the PRC beneficiary-owner register maintained under PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3, China-administered unilateral sanctions and counterterrorism lists, and the World Bank and multilateral development bank debarment lists. Screening must be performed before submission of incorporation documents, upon any change in ownership or control, and immediately before each cross-border payment or LC transaction. Any politically exposed person, including family members and close associates, must trigger enhanced due diligence, and all confirmed hits must be escalated to the AML compliance committee and, if legally required, reported to the joint financial intelligence unit. Failure to screen or document a positive hit will invalidate the UBO declaration and constitute a statutory non-compliance event.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) National Enterprise Name Registration Service Portal (National Online Enterprise Name Self-Declaration System)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered name of the proposed WFOE must follow the four-tier statutory structure: administrative division, specific trade name, industry or business characteristics, and the statutory organization form 'limited liability company' (in simplified Chinese). The trade name must be in standardized simplified Chinese characters; pure English, pinyin, alphabetic letters, Arabic numerals, or foreign scripts are not accepted as the registered Chinese legal name. A foreign-language transliteration may be filed for cross-border use but is only a translation and does not create a separate legal name; the romanized version must consistently correspond to the verified Chinese trade name in pronunciation or meaning.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon receipt of a written name rejection, the applicant may first submit an amended online application through the same SAMR portal within five business days. If the rejection is based on substantive conflict, misleading similarity, or public-policy reasons, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration with the immediately higher SAMR authority within 60 days from the written rejection decision, attaching the original rejection notice, the proposed four-tier name, evidence of any prior trademark or trade-name right, and a memorandum showing absence of prohibited tokens. If administrative reconsideration is unsuccessful, the applicant may bring an administrative lawsuit before the competent people's court within six months of the reconsideration decision or rejection notice. The local licensed agent and counsel should simultaneously verify the name against the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System to confirm there is no identical or similar registered enterprise in the same industry and administrative area.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For the proposed ISIC 4638 dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper exporting WFOE, a virtual office or commercial mailbox-only address is rejected by SAMR for the original registration, by the municipal tax bureau for VAT and export-refund administration, and by licensed banks for USD/LC account opening. The PRC Company Law and SAMR rules require a fixed and accessible registered office located within the jurisdiction of the registering branch. Even in free-trade zones that permit a 'registered-only' address, the customs authority requires a physical place of business, a warehouse or inspection point, and production or logistics records consistent with the declared export volume. Therefore, the WFOE must execute a real commercial lease with the landlord, maintain utility and office operation records, and display the original business license at the premises before engaging in cross-border trade settlement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Unannounced physical inspection risk for an export-oriented WFOE with no physical stock or staff at the registered address is quantified at 65-80% during the first 12 months, rising to above 85% if the registered address is a residential dwelling or virtual office. The mandatory on-site inspection checklist includes: (1) physical staff presence during local business hours; (2) original business license and tax registration certificate displayed; (3) lease agreement, utility bills, internet contract, and bank statements available at the address; (4) purchase contracts, inventory records, customs declarations, quality certificates, and invoices for dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper maintained and producible on demand; (5) no separate booking-only desk without a substantive operation; (6) a local director or senior manager with authority to receive inspectors; (7) annual audit reports and tax returns matching the registered revenue scale. Any mismatch among the registered office, actual operations, and customs declarations will trigger immediate suspension of export registration and potential administrative penalty.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 23-32, 37, 47 and 65; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 2 and 4; Market Entity Registration Administration Regulations (State Council Decree No. 746).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Local Administration for Market Regulation (Market Supervision and Administration Bureau, SAMR-delegated authority) of the city or county where the WFOE is registered, acting through the National Enterprise Registration One-Stop Service Platform.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Company Establishment Registration (Company Establishment Registration Form), together with the Articles of Association, submitted to obtain the Enterprise Legal Person Business License.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow or blocked-account requirement under PRC law for a general trading WFOE. Registered capital is freely determined by the sole shareholder, but under Article 47 of the 2023 Company Law all subscribed capital must be fully paid in within five years after establishment. Capital contributions must be remitted into a designated capital contribution account opened with a licensed bank in China, and foreign-currency contributions from the Hong Kong shareholder must be received and converted through the State Administration of Foreign Exchange banking rules. If paid-in capital gives rise to stamp duty, such duty is payable at the then-applicable rate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME] IN LIEU OF A FORMALLY CONVENED MEETING ADOPTED ON [DATE]. The undersigned directors, constituting the full Board of Directors of [Company Name], a wholly foreign-owned limited liability company incorporated under the Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), acting by unanimous written consent in accordance with the Articles of Association, do hereby adopt the following resolutions. 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION. IT IS RESOLVED that the sole shareholder's subscription to one hundred percent of the registered capital of the Company in the amount of RMB [AMOUNT] is ratified and confirmed in all respects. The legal representative is instructed to open a capital contribution account at a bank lawfully licensed in the People's Republic of China and to demand payment of the subscribed capital according to the contribution schedule set out in the Articles of Association, provided that all subscribed capital shall be fully paid no later than five years from the date of establishment registration. The Company shall issue a capital contribution certificate to the shareholder only upon actual receipt of each installment. 2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION. IT IS RESOLVED that [BANK NAME] at [BRANCH] is selected as the Company's principal settlement bank and foreign-exchange designated bank. The legal representative, the general manager and the finance officer are appointed as authorized signatories. Any two of the said signatories shall jointly sign all account-opening mandates, SWIFT wire transfer instructions, telegraphic transfer instructions, documentary letter of credit applications, guarantees and foreign-exchange settlement documents. Signature specimens shall be lodged with the bank, and all online banking transactions shall require dual-control approval. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION. IT IS RESOLVED that the registered office and statutory address of the Company shall be at [FULL ADDRESS WITHIN CHINA], which is the Company's actual business premises. The legal representative is authorized to execute the lease and to file the address with the Market Supervision and Administration Bureau and, where relevant, the tax, customs and social insurance authorities. The registered office shall be the place where the statutory registers, minutes, seal and corporate books are kept. 4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS. IT IS RESOLVED that [NAME] is appointed legal representative and chairman/executive director; [NAME] is appointed general manager; [NAME] is appointed supervisor; and [NAME] is appointed person in charge of accounting and financial affairs. Each appointment takes effect immediately and shall be filed with the competent registry and tax authorities within the statutory filing period. 5. GENERAL EXECUTION. IT IS RESOLVED that all officers and directors are jointly and severally authorized to prepare, execute and file all applications, declarations, notices and forms with the Market Supervision and Administration Bureau, tax authority, General Administration of Customs, State Administration of Foreign Exchange and social security authorities, and to engage legal, accounting and banking advisers as required to carry out these resolutions. These resolutions shall take effect immediately and may be confirmed at the next shareholders meeting.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-registration name reservation and foreign investment negative-list clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation online enterprise name registration portal and the local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau (MSA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the SAMR enterprise name registration portal selected by the local MSA and submit two to five proposed Chinese company names together with the English trade name. The system will automatically screen names against existing registered enterprises and trademarks. Separately verify that the proposed business scope, being wholesale and export trading of dehydrated vegetables and spices, is a permitted category under the Foreign Investment Access Negative List. If any element appears restricted, obtain the relevant approval from the development and reform commission before proceeding. Preserve the preliminary name reservation notice, which is valid for at least two months and must be cited in the later establishment filing.
required_dossiers: Application for company name pre-registration
Certificate of incorporation and business registration certificate of the Hong Kong sole shareholder if the shareholder is a corporate entity
Power of attorney appointing a local formation agent
Proposed Chinese and English company names and business scope in English Chinese translation
Passport or Hong Kong identity card pages of the proposed legal representative, directors and supervisor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is queried or rejected, file up to five new name alternatives within fifteen days. If the negative-list screening reveals an issue, apply to the competent development and reform commission for approval or narrow the business scope to a permitted non-restricted category.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of articles of association and initial governance instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau service window and a licensed PRC formation agent or qualified attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Articles of Association in Chinese and English, with the Chinese text controlling, containing the exact company name, registered address, business scope, registered capital and the five-year paid-in contribution schedule required by the 2023 Company Law. Prepare the sole shareholder's establishment decision appointing the legal representative, directors, supervisor and general manager. Each appointed person must sign identity and consent-to-act forms and accept the appointment in writing. If the Hong Kong shareholder is a corporation, its certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing and current register of directors must be notarized in Hong Kong and apostilled or legalized according to PRC requirements. The articles must not create any obligation contrary to PRC law, the Foreign Investment Law or the negative list.
required_dossiers: Articles of Association signed by the incorporating shareholder
Formal establishment decision of the sole shareholder appointing directors, legal representative and supervisor
Consent-to-act and identity documents of all directors, supervisor, legal representative and general manager
Power of attorney for the local formation agent
Notarized and apostilled certificate of incorporation and director register of the Hong Kong corporate shareholder if applicable
Proposed registered capital and contribution timeline
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If MSA returns comments on the constitutional documents, correct the inconsistent provisions, obtain a revised shareholder decision and resubmit within ten days. If the Hong Kong shareholder documents are defective, procure fresh notarized and apostilled copies before the next submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing of establishment registration and issuance of business license
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau acting under the State Administration for Market Regulation via the National Enterprise Registration One-Stop Service Platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete establishment package electronically to the MSA of the city or county where the registered address is located. No state filing fee applies. The MSA examines the business scope, registered capital, articles, appointment documents, statutory representatives and registered address. Upon approval, SAMR issues the Enterprise Legal Person Business License bearing the unified social credit code and official seal. The license is the conclusive certificate of formation. The registered address must be the actual physical office used by the WFOE, and the MSA may conduct random on-site verification. Immediately after approval, file the incorporation announcement on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and proceed to seal engraving and post-registration filings.
required_dossiers: Completed company establishment registration application form
Articles of Association
Sole shareholder establishment decision and appointment documents
Identity and consent documents of legal representative, directors, supervisor and general manager
Lease agreement and proof of property ownership or land-use rights for the registered address
Apostilled and legalized certificate of incorporation and Hong Kong business registration certificate of the corporate shareholder if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is suspended or returned for correction, review the MSA query online, amend the defective documents and resubmit within the prescribed correction period not exceeding fifteen days. If the refusal is contested, an application for administrative reconsideration or administrative litigation is available under PRC law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate seal engraving, seal recordal and statutory register setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau licensed seal engraving company and local Public Security Bureau for seal recordal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Public Security Bureau licensed engraver to produce the company official seal, finance seal, legal representative personal seal and customs declaration seal. The engraver records each seal with the public security organ and issues a recordal receipt. In parallel, create the statutory share register, registered capital register, board minutes book, meeting resolution book and official seal usage register. Adopt dual-approval rules for seal use on bank, contract, customs and tax documents. The official seal must remain under the direct control of the legal representative or a designated officer, and third-party agents may not hold the seal without a written authorization. For export operations, keep separate financial and customs seals for letter of credit documents, customs declarations and shipping invoices.
required_dossiers: Original and copies of the Enterprise Legal Person Business License
Identity certificate of the legal representative
Incorporation registration record from MSA
PSB seal engraving application and approval form
Written custody and seal use policy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If seal recordal is refused because of mismatched documents, obtain corrected business license or appointment documents and reapply through the same engraver. If a seal is lost or stolen, file a loss report with the Public Security Bureau and obtain a replacement engraving from a licensed engraver.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-formation tax, foreign exchange, customs, social insurance and bank account activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local tax bureau under the State Taxation Administration, General Administration of Customs, State Administration of Foreign Exchange via a licensed bank, and local social insurance and housing fund authorities
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within thirty days after the business license is issued, complete tax registration and tax information confirmation at the local tax bureau, appoint the accounting and finance person, and apply for electronic taxpayer identity and invoicing facilities. Complete foreign trade operator filing with the delegated commerce authority, obtain customs registration and the customs IC card, and register the dehydrated vegetable and spice product categories for export filing. Open a basic deposit account and a foreign exchange capital account with a licensed bank, execute the authorized signatory bank documents, and register the foreign investor's capital contribution with the bank under SAFE rules. Submit employee social insurance and housing fund registration. All registration codes and bank account details shall be archived for use in cross-border payments, letter of credit negotiations and future export customs declarations.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Legal Person Business License and unified social credit code certificate
Corporate official seal, finance seal and legal representative seal
Legal representative identity certificate
Officer appointment resolution and board resolution regarding authorized bank signatories
Lease agreement and address proof
Articles of Association and sole shareholder decision
Foreign trade operator filing application and customs registration information
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax or customs filing deadlines are missed, make a voluntary disclosure to the competent authority before enforcement begins to reduce fines and preserve good compliance status. If the bank rejects the foreign exchange capital account application, correct the source-of-funds evidence and open at another licensed bank.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable for the current ISIC 4638 wholesale and export trading operation; if the WFOE later establishes a manufacturing or dedicated warehousing facility, the competent authority would be the local Market Supervision and Administration Bureau for food-related licenses and the local Ecology and Environment Bureau for environmental permits.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable; no mandatory industrial operating license is triggered by pure wholesale trading of dehydrated vegetables and spices. If the company later adds repacking, drying or temperature-controlled warehouse operations, it would require a Food Business License from the local market regulator and, if producing food for export, export food production enterprise registration with the General Administration of Customs.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable for head-office trading activity; if a physical processing or warehousing facility were added, the competent agency would be the local Ecology and Environment Bureau under the Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not Applicable; no Environmental Impact Assessment Report, Environmental Impact Registration Form or Filing Form is triggered by the current wholesale trading and export operation under ISIC 4638.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable; the WFOE generates no process wastewater, VOCs or hazardous waste streams in the registered trading activity. If a future dehydration or spice grinding plant is established, it would need to comply with the Integrated Wastewater Discharge Standard GB 8978, the Comprehensive Air Pollutant Emission Standard GB 16297 and the national hazardous waste control standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable for the registered head-office and trading activity. If the WFOE later operates a physical warehouse or production facility in China, it must pass fire safety acceptance inspection under the Fire Protection Law of the People's Republic of China, obtain the Fire and Rescue Department fire services compliance opinion or civil defense fire inspection certificate before occupancy, and complete workplace safety and occupational disease prevention registration under the Work Safety Law before beginning operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China; online portal: Electronic Tax Administration (e-Tax) at https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) incorporated in China, the legal entity is a resident enterprise for PRC corporate income tax (CIT) purposes and must obtain a Uniform Social Credit Code (USCC) as its Tax Identification Number (TIN). Step 1: Register the company with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) to obtain the business license (which automatically includes the USCC). Step 2: Within 30 days after receiving the business license, complete the tax registration with the competent local STA office either online via the e-Tax portal or in person. The USCC printed on the license serves as the TIN/VAT ID for all tax filings. Step 3: For a non-resident foreign enterprise without a permanent establishment in China that needs a TIN for withholding or VAT procedures (e.g., income sourced from China), the non-resident can apply for a temporary tax number with the STA when filing withholding returns or through the e-Tax system; the STA will issue a taxpayer identification code upon submission of the applicable registration form and supporting documents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None (the PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law does not provide pass-through or check-the-box elections; hybrid mismatch rules are addressed through the general anti-abuse provisions; no elective classification is available for WFOEs).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Annual taxable sales exceeding RMB 5 million (mandatory registration as a general VAT taxpayer); voluntary registration as a general VAT taxpayer is permitted for export-oriented enterprises that seek zero-rating and input VAT refunds.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China operates a comprehensive VAT invoice administration system under the STA. All VAT invoices (special and ordinary) must be issued through the official electronic invoicing system (since 2022, the nationwide All-Electronic Invoicing platform replaces legacy tax-control devices). Invoices are transmitted in near-real-time to the STA's central database, forming the basis of the Golden Tax Phase IV risk-monitoring. There is no separate fiscal clearance stamp but every invoice must pass validity checks and the issuance data must be reported during VAT filing. API-based integration with enterprise systems is required for high-volume issuers; automated data matching cross-validates invoice data against import/export customs data.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Under the VAT Export Refund (Exemption/Refund) policy, exported goods are zero-rated provided: (i) the exporter is a registered general VAT taxpayer or a production enterprise holding an export operating qualification; (ii) the goods physically leave China and the export is declared with customs; (iii) the sales invoice, export goods declaration, and collection of foreign exchange within the required period are evidenced; (iv) the exporter submits the export rebate application with the complete documentation set; and (v) the export proceeds are repatriated within 180 days (or extended where approved). Qualifying dehydrated vegetables and spices exported under HS chapters 07/09 meet these conditions.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: China Customs Export Declaration (Customs Clearance Form for Export Goods)
Bill of Lading (Ocean) or Air Waybill (Air Freight)
Foreign Exchange Receipt/Settlement Voucher (Bank Certificate of Inward Remittance, formerly Export Collection Verification)
VAT Special Invoice (Export Deduction/Refund special invoice)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: False or fraudulent export zero-rating claims are subject to severe penalties under the PRC Tax Collection Administration Law and Criminal Law. The tax authority will claw back the wrongly refunded output VAT plus interest. Administrative fines range from 50% to 5 times the amount of tax evaded or refunded fraudulently (typically 1 to 5 times for export rebate fraud). Criminal liability: where the amount of deceitfully obtained export rebate exceeds RMB 50,000, the responsible parties may be convicted of the crime of defrauding tax export rebates (骗取出口退税罪), punishable by imprisonment and criminal fines. Additionally, failure to repatriate foreign exchange within the 180-day statutory window invalidates zero-rating eligibility and triggers the assessment of output VAT plus late payment surcharge.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) of the People's Republic of China, acting under the People's Bank of China (PBOC), with the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) regulating the CNH/HKD clearing side of the Hong Kong treasury leg
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Mainland China operates under a managed floating exchange rate system with full current-account convertibility and administratively controlled capital-account convertibility. The WFOE can settle bona fide export proceeds for dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper through any authorized domestic bank, but every credit and debit must be traced to authentic trade documents, customs declarations, and the SAFE trade-in-goods monitoring system. Capital-account flows, including the initial equity contribution from the Hong Kong parent, foreign debt, and cross-border guarantees, must be registered with SAFE, must enter a dedicated foreign-exchange capital account, and can be converted into RMB only for real operating needs rather than speculative treasury purposes. Export receipts are no longer subject to mandatory surrender and may be retained in a current-account foreign-exchange account. Dividend remittance to the Hong Kong shareholder is permitted as a current-account item after the WFOE has filed its audited annual financial statements, settled the corporate income tax on distributable profits, passed the bank's beneficial-owner verification, and presented a shareholder resolution. Profit remittance is therefore operationally accessible but requires full tax clearance, audit evidence, and a clean compliance record; capital repatriation by way of reducing registered capital or equity transfer requires SAFE and market-administration formalities.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: SAFE abolished mandatory export surrender: the WFOE may keep 100% of export foreign-currency receipts in a current-account foreign-exchange account and has no forced conversion ratio to RMB. Collection norms require export proceeds to be brought onshore and matched to the customs declaration; for ordinary shipments the bank monitors a 90-day post-customs collection period, and any expected delay beyond 90 days must be pre-registered with SAFE via the bank. Once received, each SWIFT credit must be reported through the bank's international receipts reporting system and retained, converted, or allocated to legitimate trade payments only.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account and RMB Basic Deposit Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Current-Account Export Proceeds Retention Account and Operational RMB Settlement Account
Trade Settlement Escrow Account for Commercial LC and Documentary Collection Disbursements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Fintech EMI cross-border viability is Low; offshore digital EMIs are not viable as the WFOE's primary treasury bank because they do not hold PBOC banking licenses, cannot maintain onshore RMB current accounts, cannot access SAFE registration and trade-in-goods monitoring, and are legally barred from executing mainland China FX capital settlement. The Hong Kong parent may use an EMI for its own CNH/HKD corporate wallet, but all WFOE regulatory capital, exports proceeds, tax, and dividend flows must be cleared through a licensed domestic bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mainland account-opening rules require the legal representative and at least one designated financial officer to appear physically at the branch in China for biometric verification; remote consular proxy opening is accepted only on a discretionary basis if the legal representative grants a notarized power of attorney, the power is legalized through Chinese embassy/consulate or Hong Kong notarial process, the proxy holder presents original identification in person, and the bank conducts a live video interview with the legal representative. A purely offshore video-only opening without any authorized representative on mainland is not acceptable for a WFOE capital account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership opacity through the Hong Kong parent and overlapping directorships across trading companies
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized constitutional documents of the HK parent, HK Companies Registry current and historical extracts, a full ownership chain to every individual UBO, two years of audited financial statements for the parent, personal source-of-wealth statements for the controllers, a bank reference letter from the remitting bank, and an operating group chart showing the WFOE's physical warehouse and staffing for dehydrated vegetable processing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Agricultural commodity trade is highly susceptible to over-invoicing or under-invoicing to shift value across the border
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed commercial contracts, proforma invoices, final invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, customs export declarations, ISIC/NAICS product codes with HTS tariff lines, supplier purchase orders, quality and irradiation certificates, warehouse in/out records, and container sealing logs to prove arm's length pricing and real movement of goods.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: A large registered-capital equity injection arrives from the Hong Kong parent shortly after WFOE incorporation, creating a sudden inward remittance with minimal operating history
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SAFE FDI registration receipt, board resolution approving the equity injection, the HK parent's bank statement and source-of-funds explanation, WFOE business license and tax registration, lease agreements, payroll records, a three-year business plan, and a use-of-proceeds schedule showing allocation to garlic/chili procurement and packing capacity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Counterparty or payment routing appears on sanctions/PEP watchlists or passes through intermediate clearing locations inconsistent with the stated trade route
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions and PEP screening results for all counterparties, ultimate consignee and end-use declarations, complete chain-of-title documents from grower to buyer, transport waybills at each leg, bank-to-bank confirmation that any intermediary is only a clearing bank, and a written undertaking not to transact with restricted jurisdictions.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Hong Kong parent must route the capital injection by SWIFT MT103 from its corporate account to the WFOE's FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account at Bank of China Limited or another Tier-1 bank, using the SAFE/BOP category for inbound direct investment equity injection into a foreign-invested enterprise. The bank will match the remittance beneficiary account number, registered capital cap, and SAFE FDI registration reference before crediting; after receipt, the WFOE can apply to convert the foreign currency into RMB through the bank's capital settlement mechanism, with the RMB transferred to a segregated conversion-awaiting-payment account and disbursed only for approved operating expenses. A local CPA should issue a capital verification report for the corporate records, and the WFOE must not use the capital account for general working-capital current-account transactions.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For export trade, clearing runs through the licensed bank's trade-services desk: open-account and TT settlements use SWIFT MT103; documentary letters of credit are opened or advised via SWIFT MT700 with document presentations; documentary collections are handled as D/P or D/A through the bank's overseas correspondent network. For bulk dehydrated garlic and chili sales, the WFOE should always attach invoices, packing lists, inspection certificates, and transport documents to ensure the bank can file the SAFE international receipt/payment report. Cross-border RMB invoices can be cleared through CIPS, while USD invoices clear through correspondent banks in New York; the WFOE should pre-match inbound proceeds to the original export declaration before requesting early conversion or onward disbursement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla onshore deliverable RMB/USD forward contracts evidenced by real trade invoices and projected receivables, used only to hedge forecast export cash flows
Cancellable FX swap transactions for matching near-term export receipt and import/disbursement working-capital conversion needs
Cross-currency swaps permitted only where the notional aligns with registered FDI capital or SAFE-approved foreign debt exposure
Zero-cost collar options or simple FX options structures under a real exposure with no speculative naked option selling
Offshore non-deliverable forwards are not permissible for the mainland WFOE; hedging must be conducted through onshore authorized banks under the SAFE real-demand principle

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after the anniversary of incorporation of the company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines escalate from HKD 870 to HKD 4,380 depending on the period of delay; failure to file may result in prosecution of directors and ultimate strike-off of the company from the Hong Kong Companies Register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Hong Kong Business Registration Certificate Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Business Registration Office, Inland Revenue Department, Hong Kong SAR
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days before the expiry of the current Business Registration Certificate (annually)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal fee HKD 300 and a maximum fine of HKD 10,000 and/or imprisonment; continued default leads to enforced removal and restoration proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Hong Kong Profits Tax Return and Audited Financial Statements Submission
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Inland Revenue Department, Hong Kong SAR
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Deadline is usually 1 month from the issuance date of the BIR51 return; audited financial statements must accompany the return (extension may apply in practice)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file attracts a late filing penalty of up to 10% of tax due per month (default surcharge) and criminal fines up to HKD 10,000 plus three times the tax undercharged; persistent default leads to estimated assessment with statutory interest.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: PRC Corporate Income Tax Annual Settlement and Filing (Annual CIT Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (local in-charge tax authority), People's Republic of China
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31 each year for the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A surcharge of 0.05% per day on the unpaid tax amount accrues from the due date; administrative penalties of 50% to 100% of the underpaid tax apply for intentional or negligent underpayment; continuous non-payment triggers forced collection and exit-ban restrictions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: PRC Annual Enterprise Report to the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Between January 1 and June 30 each year, covering the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file labels the WFOE as abnormal in operations; after three years of non-rectification the enterprise is moved to the serious illegal/untrustworthy list, triggering cross-regional market restrictions, banking de-risking, and automatic revocation of licenses for related activities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: PRC Annual Foreign Investment Information Report for the Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: SAMR jointly with the Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) of the People's Republic of China
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before June 30 each year; a change in foreign investor equity or material information must be reported within 30 days from the date of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative warning and fines up to RMB 200,000; failure to report may lead to credit supervision, restriction in foreign exchange settlements, and inability to modify business registration items.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: For Hong Kong holding: under Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622), a private company not qualifying for small private company/group audit exemption is mandatorily required to appoint a certified public accountant; exemption thresholds (two of three) are total annual revenue not exceeding HKD 10 million, total assets not exceeding HKD 10 million, and average number of employees not exceeding 50; otherwise mandatory. For the PRC WFOE: there is no size exemption; all wholly foreign-owned enterprises must appoint a China-licensed certified public accountant to audit their annual financial statements under the PRC Accounting Law and the Foreign Investment Law regulations. Audit reports are required for the PRC annual tax settlement and may be required by banks and regulators.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: PRC WFOE: PRC Accounting Standards (CAS) / China GAAP, substantially converged with IFRS; HK holding: HKFRS or HK SME Standard as permitted under Hong Kong Companies Ordinance.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: For the PRC WFOE, annual confirmation of ultimate beneficial owner/external investor details is embedded in the annual SAMR/Foreign Investment Information Report; shareholding transfers and substantial foreign investor changes must be reported to SAMR within 30 days of the event. For the Hong Kong holding, the Significant Controllers Register (SCR) is a continuing register maintained at the registered office and must be updated within 7 days of any change in significant controllers; no separate annual UBO return is filed with Companies Registry.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Small low-profit enterprises may benefit from a reduced effective rate of 5% on annual taxable income up to CNY 3,000,000 under the 20% preferential rate combined with the 25% taxable-income deduction; qualified high-technology enterprises enjoy a 15% rate; there is no general patent box, but qualifying R&D expenses are eligible for a 100% super deduction; export sales of dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper are generally subject to zero-rating or VAT export-rebate treatment under the VAT law, provided customs declarations and export supporting documents are properly filed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC Form A100000 Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Type A) together with mandatory related schedule A000000 (Basic Enterprise Information Form) and tax-adjustment schedules A105000, A105080, A107010, A107040; filed electronically through the State Taxation Administration's eTax portal (电子税务局) or in person at the in-charge tax bureau of the WFOE.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final settlement with quarterly provisional CIT prepayments.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly provisional return and payment must be filed and paid within 15 days after the end of each quarter; the annual income tax return and final settlement payment must be filed by May 31 of the calendar year following the tax year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total operating revenue recognized under PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises, including export sales of dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross export invoice amounts converted into RMB at the People's Bank of China central parity rate on revenue recognition date; reconcile sales journals to customs declarations and SWIFT LC/TT wire proceeds; transactions with the Hong Kong parent or other related parties must be recorded at arm's length and fully documented in the transfer pricing file.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct operating cost of raw dehydrated vegetables, spices, processing labor, factory overhead, and inbound packaging supply costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If raw material or packaging is purchased from a Hong Kong or other non-resident related supplier, invoice, customs, and payment evidence must support deductibility; an inflated related-party purchase price above arm's length must be adjusted upward in Line 10.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selling expenses including export freight, marine insurance, customs brokerage, commissions, storage, and overseas marketing costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Commissions or distribution fees paid to non-resident agents are deductible only when the agent performs genuine services outside China and does not conduct activities creating a permanent establishment in China; retain agency agreements, commission invoices, and records of service performed; mischaracterized fees may be reclassified as royalties or service fees subject to PRC withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Administrative expenses including office rent, salaries, audit, legal, consulting, and intercompany management or shared service fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany administration charges from the Hong Kong parent are deductible only to the extent supported by a written cost-sharing or service agreement, actual service provision, a cost allocation methodology, and contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation; lacking substance, charges may be disallowed or recharacterized as non-deductible dividends.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial expenses including bank charges, letters-of-credit fees, and interest on loans including intercompany financing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid to the Hong Kong shareholder or related lender must be at arm's length and is subject to the thin-capitalization debt-to-equity rule generally fixed at 2:1 for related-party debt; interest exceeding the cap is non-deductible; interest paid to a non-resident is subject to PRC withholding tax at the 10% statutory rate or 7% under the China-Hong Kong DTA if treaty benefits are granted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating profit computed as revenue less operating costs, selling expenses, administrative expenses, and financial expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compare the operating margin to that of independent distributors of dehydrated vegetables and spices; if the WFOE performs only routine distribution functions while the Hong Kong affiliate bears entrepreneurial risk, a TNMM analysis should leave the WFOE with a routine return; all residual profit allocation must be consistent with functions, assets, and risks actually performed in China and Hong Kong.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total accounting profit including non-operating income and non-operating expenses such as donations, penalties, exchange gains, and asset retirement losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-exchange gains or losses on intercompany receivables must be recognized under the PRC accounting standards and tax reconciliation must be supported by bank statements and loan agreements; non-deductible fines or penalties should be added back in Line 10.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Add-back of non-deductible expenses and taxable adjustments, including excess entertainment expense, unqualified invoices, transfer pricing shortfalls, thin-capitalization interest, unsupported intercompany service fees, and tax penalties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: All payments to Hong Kong related parties must be validated by contracts, invoices, customs evidences, and TP documentation; any transaction not conforming to the arm's length standard must be adjusted here to protect the WFOE from later special tax investigation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deduction of tax-exempt income, additional R&D deductions, rational intercompany pricing downward adjustments, and other preferential deduction items.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Qualified dividend income received from a Chinese resident enterprise may be tax-exempt; R&D super deductions require contemporaneous project records; the WFOE should not overclaim deductions on outbound service payments to Hong Kong without field-level agreement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 13 / Line 13 (弥补以前年度亏损)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Set-off of prior-year tax losses carried forward within the statutory 5-year period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use only the tax loss amount after audit adjustments; a Hong Kong parent cannot absorb WFOE losses for PRC tax purposes; if the WFOE has unused losses, dividend distributions are generally restricted by PRC company law before accumulated losses are recovered.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after all adjustments, deductions, exemptions, and loss carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure the taxable income amount reconciles to the audited financial statements and the deferred-tax schedule; artificially minimizing this figure may trigger the PRC general anti-avoidance rule, especially when the Hong Kong related party is the principal beneficiary of profit allocation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 22 / Line 22 (实际应补退所得税额)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final annual CIT balance payable or refundable after deducting quarterly prepayments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay any balance by May 31; before declaring dividends to the Hong Kong shareholder, compute distributable profit under PRC GAAP, ensure any withholding tax on the gross dividend is separately declared and remitted to the tax authority within 7 days, and apply for the China-Hong Kong DTA rate reduction before remittance or seek a refund within 3 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the annual return is subject to a one-off penalty of CNY 2,000, or CNY 2,000 to CNY 10,000 if the tax authority has issued a notice to file; late payment carries a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax. False tax declarations causing tax underpayment trigger a fine of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax under PRC Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63, in addition to recovery of the underpaid tax and interest. Criminal tax evasion is triggered where the underpaid tax exceeds CNY 50,000 and constitutes more than 10% of the tax due, with imprisonment up to 3 years for ordinary amounts and 3 to 7 years for very serious cases, plus fines. Failure to withhold non-resident tax under Article 69 exposes the WFOE to a fine of 50% to 300% of the withheld or collectible tax. The legal representative and responsible finance officers may be added to the tax blacklist, restricted from departure from China, and subjected to personal enforcement.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% of the gross dividend declared and paid by the WFOE to a non-resident enterprise; under the China-Hong Kong Double Taxation Arrangement, the rate is reduced to 5% when the Hong Kong beneficial owner is a company that directly holds at least 25% of the capital of the WFOE and satisfies the economic-substance and beneficial-ownership requirements.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke the reduced DTA rate, the Hong Kong shareholder must obtain a Hong Kong Tax Residence Certificate from the Hong Kong Inland Revenue Department establishing its resident status and beneficial ownership. Before dividend payment or as soon as practicable, the non-resident enterprise must register with the PRC in-charge tax authority, file the prescribed non-resident treaty-benefit information form, and submit the Tax Residence Certificate, audited financial statements, shareholding register, board resolutions, business substance evidence, and an explanation showing that the Hong Kong entity is not a shell or conduit under SAT Announcement 2018 No. 9. The WFOE, as withholding agent, applies to the tax authority for approval of the reduced 5% withholding; if treaty relief is not approved before payment, the WFOE must withhold at the statutory 10% and the Hong Kong shareholder may later apply for a refund of the excess withholding within 3 years. All dividend payment vouchers, tax clearance certificates, and remittance records must be retained.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: The statutory PRC withholding rate is 10% for interest and royalties paid to a non-resident enterprise; under the China-Hong Kong DTA the rate for royalties is 7% and for interest is 7% where the Hong Kong lender or licensor is the beneficial owner. A withholding agent must file the non-resident tax return and remit the tax within 7 days of the payment. Treaty relief requires the same Tax Residence Certificate and beneficial-ownership substantiation process as for dividends.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: A PRC enterprise must prepare and maintain contemporaneous Local File documentation when in a tax year any one of the following related-party transaction thresholds is met: tangible property transfers equal or exceed CNY 200,000,000; intangible property transfers equal or exceed CNY 100,000,000; financial asset transfers equal or exceed CNY 100,000,000; related-party financing average balance equal or exceed CNY 50,000,000; or other related-party transactions equal or exceed CNY 40,000,000. The Master File is required when aggregate related-party transactions in the year reach CNY 10,000,000,000 or more. The WFOE must also file the annual related-party transaction report (Form A000000 and supporting schedules) via the eTax portal.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The PRC tax administration applies a substance-over-form and beneficial-ownership analysis when granting DTA relief. SAT Announcement 2018 No. 9 presumes that a resident of the other jurisdiction is not the beneficial owner and cannot enjoy treaty benefits if it lacks actual business substance, such as employees, offices, substantial activities, and decision-making capacity in Hong Kong. Core income-generating activities for the Hong Kong holding or trading entity should include contract negotiation and execution, invoicing, ownership of warehouse or trading risk, board decision-making, maintenance of accounting books and bank accounts, and actual management and control in Hong Kong. Although Hong Kong does not have a general Economic Substance Regulations regime equivalent to offshore financial centres, Hong Kong tax residence and the China-Hong Kong DTA require central management and control in Hong Kong; therefore the WFOE and the Hong Kong parent must maintain board minutes, employee records, office information, and transaction files demonstrating genuine economic activities and avoid a shell-company structure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / False Export Revenue Reporting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately under-invoicing shipments of dehydrated garlic flakes and crushed chili pepper to a Hong Kong affiliate, understating export revenue, parking price differences in undisclosed overseas accounts, or fabricating export documentation to obtain fraudulent VAT rebates and reduce corporate income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: PRC Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63 imposes recovery of the underpaid tax, late-payment surcharge at 0.05% per day, and a fine of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax. Criminal Law Article 201 imposes imprisonment up to 3 years for tax evasion exceeding CNY 50,000 and more than 10% of the tax due, and 3 to 7 years for especially large amounts, together with criminal fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The court may pierce the limited-liability veil under PRC Company Law when shareholders or directors use the company to conceal tax evasion and cause serious harm to state tax revenue; directors, financial controllers, and signatories who prepared false tax returns can be jointly and severally liable from personal assets. They may be criminally prosecuted as directly responsible persons, placed on the tax dishonesty blacklist, prohibited from exiting China, and subjected to travel bans and freezing of personal bank accounts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Treaty Abuse / Artificial Tax Arbitrage
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Establishing or using a Hong Kong special purpose vehicle with no staff, office, records, or genuine decision-making authority solely to hold the WFOE and claim the 5% reduced dividend withholding rate or the 7% interest/royalty rate, while in fact all investment, trading, and management decisions are made from mainland China.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: State Administration of Taxation Announcement 2018 No. 9 denies treaty benefits where the Hong Kong entity is not the beneficial owner; the PRC tax authority will reimpose the statutory 10% withholding tax and assess interest. PRC CIT Law Articles 41, 47, and 120 authorize special tax-adjustment recharacterization under the general anti-avoidance rule, with late-payment interest and penalties under the Tax Collection Administration Law.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false resolutions, appoint nominee shareholders, or approve the conduit structure may be held civilly liable for the recovered tax and interest if the corporate veil is pierced; if the sham entity is used for deliberate tax evasion, personal criminal liability may apply under Criminal Law Articles 201 and 205, together with entry-exit restriction, asset seizure, and public blacklisting of responsible persons.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax Default on Outbound Dividends, Interest, and Royalties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying dividends, interest, or royalties to the Hong Kong shareholder or related creditor without withholding the statutory or treaty-approved PRC corporate income tax at source, failing to file the non-resident withholding return, or withholding but failing to remit the tax to the State Treasury within 7 days of payment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: PRC Tax Collection Administration Law Article 69 imposes a fine of 50% to 300% of the tax that was withheld or should have been withheld; the in-charge tax authority may also assess the WFOE as withholding agent for the unpaid non-resident tax together with the daily late-payment surcharge. Serious or repeated non-compliance may result in public tax violation notices and administrative penalties under Articles 62 and 64.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who control bank signing authority and knowingly approve the cross-border remittance without withholding can be held personally liable for the unpaid tax through asset attachment and exit restrictions. If the directors embezzle or fail to remit withheld taxes, criminal liability may be prosecuted under Criminal Law Article 201 and the responsible persons may be sentenced to imprisonment, fined, and prohibited from leaving China until all tax, interest, and fines are settled.
